name: Capital One Savor Cash Rewards Credit Card

welcome_offer.description: Earn a one-time $200 cash bonus once you spend $500 on purchases within the first 3 months from account opening.
notes: Official Capital One Savor page checked 2026-10-02 shows the standard $200 bonus; the earlier $250 limited-time offer has ended.
This is Capital One Savor, not the separate SavorOne card.

earning_rates.notes: 8% cash back on Capital One Entertainment purchases
Hotels, vacation rentals and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel
Unlimited cash back at grocery stores; excludes superstores like Walmart and Target
Unlimited cash back on select streaming services
Unlimited cash back on all other purchases

sources.notes: Official Capital One page checked 2026-10-02: $0 fee; $200 after $500 in 3 months; 8% Capital One Entertainment, 5% hotels/vacation rentals/rental cars via Capital One Travel, 3% grocery/dining/entertainment/streaming, 1% other.
Secondary source corroborating the limited-time $250 cash bonus after $500 spend in the first 3 months.
